scientific_integrity: Exhaustive integer-state enumeration over 3^15 states per graph by two independently implemented functional-graph algorithms, plus all spatial automorphisms checked. No probabilistic sampling or unproved global extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite classification only for the fifteen-vertex line graphs of GP(5,1) and GP(5,2). The exact exceptional-count preservation is not claimed for all cubic graphs or all line graphs. Source-priority uncertainty and absence of independent external audit remain.
title: Exceptional excitation clocks survive line-graph expansion of two generalized Petersen graphs
